sq_intro: The Squadra Tre is the team behind the team: school friends, family, neighbours, karting mates and everyone who follows Luigi on Instagram. Joining is free – upload a photo and you are on our Wall of Fame.
sq_s1: Name, email and ideally a selfie – with helmet, flag or fan shirt.
sq_s2: One click in your inbox. Under 16? A parent confirms.
sq_s3: After our review you appear online – and at season end on the printed photo wall at the race tent.
